div.head: Northu 10
div.ab: Æghwilc cild sy, we lærað, gefullod binnon nigon nihton, be wite VI ór.
Æghwilc cild sy, we lærað, gefullod binnon nigon nihton, be wite VI or.
Jedes Kind, verordnen wir, werde binnen 9 Tagen getauft, bei Strafe: 6 Ör.
Every child, we direct, shall be baptised within 9 days, on pain of a fine of 6 ores.
We instruct that every child is to be baptised within nine days, under penalty of 6 ores.
We instruct that every child is to be baptized within nine nights, or there will be a fine of six oras.

note.label: contrast
note.quote: Northu. 10 – 10:1, which allowed nine days to baptize an infant, whereas Ine 2 - 2:1 ... allowed 30 days

div.note: U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘We instruct that every child is to be baptised within nine days, under penalty of six ores.’).

note.seg: Gedanklich gehört 10 zw. 8 u. 10, 1; Nachtrag scheint 9
In sense 10 belongs between 8 and 10, 1; 9 appears to be an addition
